# Current log

Turn the approach channel's current readings into the windows a tow can be
moved in.

## Steps

1. Read the current log for the dates in question.
2. Keep every stretch where the current stays below the towing limit for at
   least 45 minutes.
3. Report each window as a start time, an end time, and the peak current
   inside it.

Report the channel's timezone with every time, and say which limit was
applied.
